recognize_zh: A–F 的成熟小淋巴球細胞質內有許多大小一致、邊界清楚的圓形空泡，常排成一圈圍繞核；G 為對照的嗜中性球與單核球空泡。成熟淋巴球出現明顯空泡應懷疑溶小體儲積症。
features: Panels A–F: small to medium mature lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei and condensed chromatin
Multiple discrete, sharply punched-out, clear round cytoplasmic vacuoles in lymphocytes
Vacuoles often arranged around the nucleus in a rim of pale blue cytoplasm
No azurophilic granules or inclusions within the vacuoles
Panel G: comparison neutrophil and monocyte with cytoplasmic vacuolation
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature lymphocytes (panels A–F) containing numerous discrete, sharply defined clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, often forming a rim around the nucleus. Lymphocyte nuclei are otherwise mature with condensed chromatin, and no abnormal granules are identified. Panel G shows vacuolation in a neutrophil and monocyte for comparison, a nonspecific finding in phagocytic cells. Vacuolated mature lymphocytes are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder, which in this patient was confirmed as galactosialidosis (CTSA mutation).

ddx.vs: MPS characteristically shows Alder-Reilly granules and Gasser cells with elevated urine glycosaminoglycans, which were normal here.

ddx.dx: Other storage disorders with vacuolated lymphocytes (Pompe, Wolman, Niemann-Pick, juvenile Batten, sialidosis)
ddx.vs: These share lymphocyte vacuolation, so separation depends on enzyme assays and genetic testing rather than morphology.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and nucleoli, rather than mature small lymphocytes with clear vacuoles.
Storage artifact vacuolates neutrophils and monocytes in delayed samples and rarely produces uniform discrete vacuoles in mature lymphocytes.
